g.text: Recommended Global Command Structure - Agent Help Proposal
No catalog formatting, model call, or refresh.
No prompt or binding details in the response.
Cache reads serialize with Agent publication.
Target-only global proposal; green marks the Help metadata path.
Repeated collaborators are grouped, not omitted.
Core/application services are singleton; response data is request-scoped.
RuntimePorts includes singleton services and execution-scoped Session objects.
